mapper.select: SELECT id,payment_order_id,payment_channel_suborder_id,rent_allocated_amount_fen rent,deposit_allocated_amount_fen deposit, freight_prepaid_allocated_fen freight,total_allocated_amount_fen total,service_fee_allocated_fen+compensation_allocated_amount_fen+custom_goods_allocated_amount_fen other FROM payment_allocation WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND payment_order_id IN (SELECT id FROM payment_order WHERE payment_scene='initial_order') ORDER BY payment_channel_suborder_id
mapper.update: UPDATE rental_order_freight_account f SET f.freight_status='settled',f.settled_at=#{at},f.updated_at=#{at},f.version=f.version+1 WHERE f.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen=0 AND f.online_settle_amount_fen=0 AND f.refunded_amount_fen=0 AND f.freight_status='prepaid' AND 2=(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_transport_leg l WHERE l.rental_order_id=f.rental_order_id AND l.charge_mode IN ('none','cod'))

UPDATE rental_order o JOIN order_return_check c ON c.rental_order_id=o.id JOIN rental_order_freight_account f ON f.rental_order_id=o.id SET o.order_status='completed',o.version=o.version+1,o.updated_at=#{at} WHERE o.id=#{orderId} AND o.order_status='return_checking' AND ((c.check_status IN ('no_issue','admin_closed','auto_closed') AND c.claim_created=0) OR (c.check_status='claim_submitted' AND c.claim_created=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.return_check_id=c.id AND cl.claim_status='closed'))) AND c.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.freight_status='settled' AND f.initial_prepaid_amount_fen=f.online_settle_amount_fen+f.refunded_amount_fen AND o.deposit_refunded_amount_fen+o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen=o.deposit_paid_amount_fen AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_event e WHERE e.rental_order_id=o.id AND e.event_idempotency_key=CONCAT('return:',c.id,':complete')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_allocation a WHERE a.rental_order_id=o.id) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.reservation_status='completed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservation r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.reservation_status IN ('held','paid_locked','renting','overdue_holding','disputed_holding')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM refund_order r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.refund_status NOT IN ('success','cancelled'))
mapper.sql: NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_event e WHERE e.rental_order_id=o.id AND e.event_idempotency_key=CONCAT('return:',c.id,':complete')) OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_fulfillment_event e WHERE e.rental_order_id=o.id AND e.event_idempotency_key=CONCAT('return:',c.id,':closed')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservation r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.reservation_status IN ('renting','overdue_holding')) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_transport_leg l WHERE l.rental_order_id=o.id AND l.leg_type='return' AND l.leg_status<>'completed') OR o.deposit_paid_amount_fen-o.deposit_deducted_amount_fen>(SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.deposit_refund_amount_fen),0) FROM refund_order r WHERE r.rental_order_id=o.id AND r.refund_status<>'cancelled') OR (c.check_status IN ('admin_closed','auto_closed') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM admin_case k JOIN admin_case_action parent ON parent.admin_case_id=k.id AND parent.parent_action_id IS NULL AND parent.target_id=c.id WHERE k.rental_order_id=o.id AND k.case_status='closed' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_case_action child WHERE child.parent_action_id=parent.id AND child.step_no BETWEEN 1 AND 4)=4))

SELECT o.id FROM rental_order o JOIN order_return_check c ON c.rental_order_id=o.id WHERE ((c.check_status='claim_submitted' AND c.claim_created=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM order_claim cl WHERE cl.return_check_id=c.id AND cl.claim_status='closed')) AND o.order_status='return_checking' OR c.check_status IN ('no_issue','admin_closed','auto_closed') AND c.claim_created=0) AND c.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND (o.order_status='return_checking' OR (o.order_status='completed' AND ())) AND o.id>#{afterId} ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100
